title: Fishers of Men
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Jesus went to Galilee, by a big lake. He taught, “Turn back to Heavenly Father, and believe the good news!”
By the water, Jesus saw two brothers, Simon and Andrew. They were fishermen, throwing their net into the lake. Jesus said, “Come, follow Me. I will make you fishers of men.”
What did He mean? They gathered fish into nets. Now Jesus would teach them to gather people to Heavenly Father.
p2: Right away, Simon and Andrew left their nets and followed Him. Then Jesus saw James and John fixing nets in a boat with their father.
Jesus called them too. Right away they left the boat and went with Him. Tonight, think of one way you can follow Jesus tomorrow.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
